input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: The only TrueLink-side warranty in the Agreement (Section 9, p0059-p0060) is a Y2K date-processing warranty. There is no warranty that the Hosting Services or Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, no conformance-to-documentation warranty for the Interface or related software, no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty running from TrueLink, and no repair/replace/refund remedy. Section 8 by contrast imposes compliance-with-laws, IP and malicious-code warranties on Client, so the warranty burden is effectively one-directional. Section 12 (p0076) then disclaims all implied warranties of merchantability and fitness "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT" - the carve-out is properly worded, but with no express performance warranty to carve out, the practical result approaches the walk-away "AS IS" position. This fails the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies) on a material term, so we insert the express warranty and remedy after p0060 at the preferred period (12 months software, professional and workmanlike services), noting the 90/30-day fallback in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add an express TrueLink performance and conformance warranty with a repair/replace/refund remedy to Section 9.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only a Y2K warranty, so TrueLink currently stands behind neither the Interface nor the Hosting and Support Services, while Section 12 disclaims all implied warranties. We have added our standard performance and conformance warranty with a repair, replacement or refund remedy; we can accept a 90-day software / 30-day services period as a fallback.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that (a) the Hosting Services and the Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (b) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation and to the specifications agreed by the parties; (c) it will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement; and (d) the Interface and all related software will, at the time delivered or made available to Client, be free from viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code. Client's remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties is, at TrueLink's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the compensation paid for the non-conforming services, Interface or software.
